block.prompt:
Imagine you are a new student at an English-speaking school. You have to introduce yourself to the class via a short written poster (profile card). Fill in the sections and write 2–3 full sentences about your hobbies and why you like them.

My Profile:
- Name:
- Age:
- From:
- Family:
- Favourite subject:
- Hobbies: (2–3 sentences in English)
block.answer_key:
Hobbies model: I love playing football with my friends after school. I also like reading adventure books because they are exciting. At weekends, I sometimes cook with my mum.

(Any real, personal content is acceptable; 'why I like it' = 'because + reason' is the target construction.)

levels: All sections filled, 2–3 sentences on hobbies
Most sections filled, 1 sentence on hobbies
Because + reason used at least once

watch_outs: Schüler:innen neigen dazu, nur zu listen ('I like football, reading, cooking.') — auf 'because + reason' bestehen
Profilkarte als Klassenausstellung oder Lernkartei verwenden — das motiviert zur sorgfältigen Schreibqualität
Schreibfehler in Kl.1 tolerieren, solange der Inhalt verständlich ist; Fokus liegt auf dem Sprechen (dieses Blatt als Basis für die mündliche Vorstellung)

subject: Erste lebende Fremdsprache
kompetenzbereich: Sprechen (an Gesprächen teilnehmen und zusammenhängend sprechen)
